MERGE INTO REP_FLOAT_FEE RFF USING ( SELECT #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{pProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} P_PROD_ID, #{affirmDate,jdbcType=DATE} AFFIRM_DATE, #{businessCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BUSINESS_CODE, #{affirmNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AFFIRM_NUM, #{affirmAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AFFIRM_AMT, #{aboveAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ABOVE_AMT, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON(RFF.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID and RFF.AFFIRM_DATE = TEMP.AFFIRM_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RFF.P_PROD_ID = TEMP.P_PROD_ID, RFF.BUSINESS_CODE = TEMP.BUSINESS_CODE, RFF.AFFIRM_NUM = TEMP.AFFIRM_NUM, RFF.AFFIRM_AMT = TEMP.AFFIRM_AMT, RFF.ABOVE_AMT = TEMP.ABOVE_AMT, RFF.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RFF.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, RFF.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RFF.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RFF.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RFF.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_ID,P_PROD_ID,AFFIRM_DATE, BUSINESS_CODE,AFFIRM_NUM,AFFIRM_AMT, ABOVE_AMT,STATUS,CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT,UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES(TEMP.PROD_ID,TEMP.P_PROD_ID,TEMP.AFFIRM_DATE, TEMP.BUSINESS_CODE,TEMP.AFFIRM_NUM,TEMP.AFFIRM_AMT, TEMP.ABOVE_AMT,TEMP.STATUS,TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT,TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
